---
name: my-skill
description: Use this skill whenever building or changing any page of the Saffron Crumb home bakery website.
---

1. Brand name is "Saffron Crumb". Tagline: "Fresh from a Lahore home kitchen." Tone: warm, friendly, simple English, short sentences.
2. Colours: page background #FFF8EE, main text #3B2A1A, primary colour for buttons, links and headings #C2410C, accent #F4B942, cards #FFFFFF with a #EADBC8 border.
3. Fonts: headings use "Playfair Display", body text uses "Poppins", both loaded from Google Fonts, with serif and sans-serif as fallbacks.
4. Every page has a top bar with the text logo "Saffron Crumb" and links to Home, Menu, About and Order, and a footer reading "© 2026 Saffron Crumb · Lahore · Sample site for DISC 472".
5. Prices are always written as "Rs 1,250": "Rs", a space, commas for thousands, no decimals. Dates are written as "12 Dec 2026" and times as "4:00 pm".
6. Menu items are shown as cards with an emoji, the name, a one-line description and the price, grouped by category: Cakes, Cookies & Brownies, Savoury.
7. Buttons have 12px rounded corners, the primary colour and white text. Each section has one main call to action, such as "Place an order".
8. Forms: every field has a visible label. The phone number must be exactly 11 digits starting with 03. Errors appear under the field in #B91C1C, and a thank-you message appears on success. No data is sent anywhere.
9. Mobile first: the page works at 375px wide with no sideways scrolling. The menu grid has 1 column on phones, 2 on tablets and 3 on desktops.
10. Keep it simple: plain HTML, CSS and a little JavaScript, with no frameworks and no build step. The home page is index.html in the main folder.
11. Use emoji or CSS shapes for pictures. Never link to outside images.
12. Never invent reviews, star ratings, customer counts or "trusted by" lines.
